dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Minimal falcation; trailing edge presents as a near-linear spline with slight concave curvature at the basal insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with minimal pixel radius terminating in a sharp vertex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55-60 degrees relative to the dorsal longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.4:1 ratio of maximum basal width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Extremely large radius resulting in a nearly linear, low-poly slope from the cranial peak to the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thickened triangular projection with length approximately equal to its basal thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: High obtuse angle at the transition point between the cranial slope and the dorsal rostrum ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced low-polygon topology and simplified texture mapping characteristic of a digital asset rather than a biological organism.
